_readme: Pre-import coverage % per instrument x locale - the 'before' column of TRANSLATION-STATUS-2026-08-27.md.
Every row is the number the wave's own patch note records for the build the Aug-21 import replaced,
not a plan estimate (the plan's F2 baseline of 707 label objects / fil 75% was wrong):
F1 = generate_dcf.py after the Task 16 English alignment, before Task 17's import (v4.0.0 maps),
F4 = pre-wave v3.1.4, counted against the SAME Aug-21 English key set as the shipped row,
- fil 533 / ceb 550 / bis 549 / ilo 554 / hil 530 / war 565 / bcl 547 of 740 label objects.
F1/F3/F4 percentages are truncated (cspro_helpers.py prints int division); F2's are rounded
(f2-coverage.py uses round()). Locale case follows each source: upper for CSPro, lower for the PWA.
